ValidationRule.description: Stage gate: Contract renewals, Terms proposed and later stages need Amount, Pricing model and Contract term (months).
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: AND(RecordType.DeveloperName = "Contract_renewals", CASE(StageName, "Upcoming", 1, "Review meeting", 2, "Terms proposed", 3, "Awaiting signature", 4, "Renewed", 5, 0) >= 3, OR(ISBLANK(Amount), ISBLANK(TEXT(Pricing_model__c)), ISBLANK(Contract_term_months__c)))
ValidationRule.errorMessage: Fill in Amount, Pricing model and Contract term (months) before moving to Terms proposed.
